entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I need some help with an order. I bought a ProFit jersey a little while ago, and I need to start a return.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the jersey, or a matter of preference?
It's a preference issue. It's simply the wrong size. I've found that it's way too tight in the arms, and I'd like to do an exchange for a larger size if possible.
I see. Thanks for clarifying. Let me just pull up your order information. Can I get your name or order number?
Of course. The order number is VF8675309.

Thank you... one moment. Okay, I have it here. I see the ProFit jersey was delivered 46 days ago. You're unfortunately outside our 10-day return window, so I can absolutely process that exchange for you. No problem at all.

That's great news. Thank you. Now, since I do have to go through the trouble of repackaging this and dropping it off, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase? Just for the inconvenience.

I understand the request, and I'm happy we can get the correct size for you. However, our policy doesn't allow for goodwill credits or discounts for a fit preference exchange. The approved exchange for the new jersey is the solution I can offer.
Okay, I get it. What about just covering the shipping on the new item then? That seems fair.

The standard shipping for the replacement jersey is already included as part of the exchange process, so you won't be charged for that. I'm generating a prepaid return label for you now, which I'll send to your email on file. Just use that to send back the one that's too tight.
Alright, that works for me. As long as I can get the exchange sorted out, I'm happy. Thanks for your help.
You're very welcome. The email is on its way. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
